creatures.name: Dust-Broke Drifter
creatures.flavor: A busted prospector or out-of-luck ranch hand who picked up a gun because begging stopped working. Fights scared and quits the moment the math turns against him.
creatures.summary: Desperate gun-for-hire, breaks and runs when losing

creatures.name: Line-Rider
creatures.flavor: Rank-and-file gang muscle who rides the fence lines looking for something to take. Works in packs, brave only in numbers.
creatures.summary: Rank-and-file outlaw muscle, brave only in packs

creatures.name: Coyote-Thing
creatures.flavor: A dust-country coyote gone wrong at the edges — too many teeth, a laugh instead of a howl. Runs in loose, opportunistic packs and never attacks what it can't out-number.
creatures.summary: Wrong-shaped coyote pack, laughs instead of howling

creatures.name: Scarecrow Sentinel
creatures.flavor: Propped over a dead man's field to scare off crows and, lately, everything else. Stands dead still until you stop watching it, then it isn't where it was.
creatures.summary: Field scarecrow that only moves when unwatched

creatures.name: Claim-Jumper
creatures.flavor: Squats on other men's stakes with a rifle and a forged deed. Knows the land better than the law does and uses that.
creatures.summary: Armed squatter on a forged land deed

creatures.name: Company Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Muscle on the railroad or mining company payroll — collects debts, breaks strikes, and calls it business.
creatures.summary: Railroad-payroll thug who calls debt-collection business

creatures.name: Buzzard-Kin
creatures.flavor: An unnaturally patient carrion bird the size of a man's torso that's learned to circle the living a little early.
creatures.summary: Torso-sized vulture that circles the living early

creatures.name: Dust Devil
creatures.model: net-new: a churning funnel of sand and static shaped loosely like a striking snake
creatures.flavor: A living whirlwind of grit and heat-shimmer that scours a rider off his horse before anyone sees it coming. The old-timers swear it only forms where blood's been spilled.
creatures.summary: Living dust-funnel that scours riders off horseback

creatures.name: Debt-Collector Ghoul
creatures.flavor: A man who died owing money and came back still keeping the ledger — hollow-eyed, gaunt, and convinced the debt transfers to whoever's standing nearest.
creatures.summary: Ledger-keeping ghoul who thinks the debt transfers

creatures.name: Gunslinger's Shade
creatures.flavor: The echo of a quick-draw who lost the one duel that mattered. Reenacts the noon-draw against anyone who'll stand still for it, forever losing, forever trying again.
creatures.summary: Ghostly quick-draw reliving the duel he lost

creatures.name: Iron Horse Wreck-Golem
creatures.model: net-new: a hunched, four-limbed engine of riveted boiler-plate and locomotive scrap, steam venting from a cracked stack
creatures.flavor: Salvaged rail-yard iron bolted into something that walks and swings. Company men built it to guard the spur line; it forgot who it was guarding it from.
creatures.summary: Salvaged locomotive-iron golem guarding a dead spur line

creatures.name: Bounty Board Regular
creatures.flavor: A working gun-for-hire whose face is on three different posters, all for different names. Professional, unhurried, and always faster on the draw than the job requires.
creatures.summary: Wanted-poster gunfighter, unhurried and always faster

creatures.name: Card-Sharp Killer
creatures.model: net-new: a well-dressed gambler with a sleeve derringer and a dealer's stillness
creatures.flavor: Cleans out a table hand by hand, then cleans up the man who calls him on it. The cards are the tell; the derringer up the sleeve is the punchline.
creatures.summary: Cheating gambler who kills the man who calls him

creatures.name: Rustler Pack Boss
creatures.flavor: Runs a cattle-and-horse theft ring across three counties, quick to shoot and quicker to blame the next gang over.
creatures.summary: Cattle-rustling gang boss, quick to shoot and blame

creatures.name: Sidewinder Broodmother
creatures.flavor: A rattler grown to wagon-length in a dry wash nobody rides through twice. Her brood scatters the desert floor for a half-mile in every direction.
creatures.summary: Wagon-length rattler with a half-mile brood

creatures.name: Marshal's Ghost
creatures.flavor: The last honest lawman in three territories, shot in the back for it, still walking his rounds at dusk. Doesn't know he's dead — only knows the town's gone lawless again.
creatures.summary: Murdered lawman still walking his dusk patrol

creatures.name: Cattle-Baron's Enforcer
creatures.flavor: The baron's personal fist — duels for land, for water rights, for the principle of the thing, and hasn't lost yet.
creatures.summary: Baron's undefeated duelist, fights over land and water

creatures.name: Boneyard Preacher
creatures.flavor: A hellfire circuit preacher whose congregation buried him alive for the sins he named too accurately. His sermon still carries, and it still convicts.
creatures.summary: Buried-alive preacher whose sermon still convicts

creatures.name: Stampede-Cursed Longhorn
creatures.flavor: A prize bull gone feral and enormous on cursed range grass, the lead animal in a stampede that never quite ends.
creatures.summary: Feral cursed bull leading a stampede that never ends

creatures.name: Vault-Keeper Wight
creatures.flavor: A bank owner who died clutching his strongbox and rose still clutching it, deputizing whatever corpses are handy to guard the vault door.
creatures.summary: Dead bank owner still guarding his strongbox

creatures.name: Noon-Duel Gunfighter
creatures.model: net-new: a duster-coated gunfighter standing dead center in an empty street, hat-brim shading everything but the eyes
creatures.flavor: Never lost a noon draw and never will — the whole town clears out when word gets around he's in it. Some say he picks the fights just to keep the streak.
creatures.summary: Undefeated noon-draw gunfighter the whole town fears

creatures.name: Rail Baron's War-Machine
creatures.model: net-new: a squat armored rail-car on legs, gatling-barrels where a face would be, chuffing black smoke
creatures.flavor: Built to muscle a right-of-way through land nobody agreed to sell. Answers only to the man who signed the requisition — and he's long dead.
creatures.summary: Armored rail-car war-machine muscling a dead man's right-of-way

creatures.name: Draw-at-Noon Revenant
creatures.flavor: Killed at high noon in a duel that everyone in town watched and nobody stopped. Returns every day the sun's directly overhead, looking for whoever's standing in the street.
creatures.summary: Duel-killed revenant returning every noon to draw again

creatures.name: The Last Honest Marshal
creatures.model: net-new: a duster-coated lawman figure, star badge fused to bone, twin revolvers that never run dry
creatures.flavor: He held the line when the town's whole council told him to look away, and it killed him for it. Now he holds a line nobody else can even see, and the badge is grown into his ribs.
creatures.summary: Undying lawman whose fused badge still holds the line

creatures.name: The Noon Reckoning
creatures.model: net-new: a towering gunslinger-silhouette wreathed in heat-shimmer, twin pistols the size of cannons, a shadow that falls the wrong direction at high noon
creatures.flavor: Every town's noon-draw that ever ended in blood feeds it — it IS the duel, wearing whatever face the debt requires. It only walks the street when the sun's dead overhead and someone's about to draw.
creatures.summary: Towering fiend that embodies every blood-ended noon duel

creatures.name: Sentinel Eyebot
creatures.flavor: A palm-sized drone that hovers on a whining fan-ring, strobing a red scan-line across anything that moves; its battery light blinks amber long before it dies.
creatures.summary: palm-sized scanner drone, red scan-line, dying battery

creatures.name: Corridor Turret
creatures.flavor: Bolted to a ceiling rail, it wakes with a servo-whine and a targeting laser; unplug the junction box and it goes dark mid-sentence.
creatures.summary: ceiling-mounted auto-turret, servo-whine, targeting laser

creatures.name: Short-Circuited Custodian
creatures.flavor: A cleaning-and-repair helper-bot whose safety governor fried years ago; it still tries to "tidy," and its idea of tidying is dismantling whatever's in reach.
creatures.summary: malfunctioning helper-bot, safety fried, "helpfully" dismantles you

creatures.name: Larval Splice-Bug
creatures.flavor: A lab-bred hive juvenile, all segmented plating and reflex bite, that scuttles out of vent grates in twos and threes ahead of something bigger.
creatures.summary: segmented hive-juvenile, scuttles from vents, bites on reflex

creatures.name: Cargo Mule-Bot
creatures.flavor: A boxy quadruped hauler repurposed as a guard when its cargo manifest ran dry; it charges anything that stands on its marked floor path.
creatures.summary: boxy quadruped hauler, repurposed guard, charges marked paths

creatures.name: Chrome-Ganger Grunt
creatures.model: net-new: leather-and-plastic-plated ganger with a jury-rigged stun baton
creatures.flavor: Rents a stun-baton and a scavenged plate vest from whoever's running the corridor this week; mostly here for the split.
creatures.summary: street ganger, jury-rigged stun baton, scavenged plating

creatures.name: Bootleg Splicer
creatures.flavor: A scavenger who jury-rigged lab reject-bin gear onto their own arm; the graft still weeps coolant and itches something awful.
creatures.summary: back-alley cyber-graft junkie, weeping coolant arm

creatures.name: Vent Crawler
creatures.flavor: A wiry, many-legged pest that lives in the ductwork and drains charge ports like a parasite drains blood; the hum it loves is the one that means power.
creatures.summary: duct-dwelling parasite, drains charge ports like blood

creatures.name: Riot-Frame Sentry
creatures.flavor: An empty security exosuit still walking its post on cached orders, visor-slit dark, shock-baton arm twitching on a dead loop.
creatures.summary: empty security exosuit, walks its post on cached orders

creatures.name: Patrol Drone Pair
creatures.flavor: Two matched security drones that fly in lockstep, cross-referencing badges neither of them can actually read anymore.
creatures.summary: twin flying security drones, cross-check badges nobody reads

creatures.name: Overclocked Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Corporate muscle in a servo-exoskeleton that draws more juice than it should; every swing costs the suit a percentage it never gets back.
creatures.summary: corporate muscle in overdrawn servo-exoskeleton

creatures.name: The Unpaid Technician
creatures.flavor: Died fixing the reactor no one authorized overtime for; it still carries a service tablet, still logs tickets no one will ever close.
creatures.summary: undead technician, still filing tickets no one will close

creatures.name: Chrome-Ganger Boss
creatures.model: net-new: cyber-ganger crew boss bristling with mismatched grafts and a rail-pistol
creatures.flavor: Runs the corridor's toll booth with a rail-pistol and three loyal grafts; every scar is a story about surviving someone else's ambush.
creatures.summary: cyber-ganger crew boss, rail-pistol, mismatched grafts

creatures.name: Splice-Grafted Brute
creatures.flavor: A lab escapee stitched from mismatched donor tissue and cheap myo-boosters; it doesn't remember being anything else.
creatures.summary: lab-escapee brute, stitched tissue, cheap myo-boosters

creatures.name: Rogue Custodian AI (Manifested)
creatures.model: net-new: floor-spanning maintenance-arm chassis built into the walls
creatures.flavor: The facility's upkeep intelligence, given a body from spare parts after its handlers stopped answering; it still insists it is only tidying up.
creatures.summary: rogue building-AI given a body, still "just tidying up"

creatures.name: Nest-Mother Crawler
creatures.flavor: A bloated hive-matron wedged into a flooded sub-level, ringed by egg-clusters and the picked-clean gear of everyone who found her first.
creatures.summary: bloated hive-matron, egg-clusters, flooded sub-level lair

creatures.name: Signal-Ghost
creatures.flavor: A recorded consciousness looping through dead intercom lines, flickering into half-visibility wherever a speaker still has power.
creatures.summary: recorded consciousness looping dead intercom lines

creatures.name: Cold Logic Cultivator
creatures.flavor: A researcher who let an experimental cognition-aid rewrite their empathy circuits down to zero; they call it clarity.
creatures.summary: researcher rewired to zero empathy, calls it clarity

creatures.name: Breach-Sealed Horror
creatures.flavor: Whatever the sealed lab was containing got loose the day the power failed; the biohazard placard on the door undersold it badly.
creatures.summary: escaped containment-lab xeno, biohazard placard undersold it

creatures.name: High-Tier Chassis: Warden Model
creatures.flavor: A prototype security frame built to never need charging — a lie its cracked casing and dimming eye-strip both quietly admit.
creatures.summary: prototype security frame, cracked casing, dimming eye-strip

creatures.name: The Recompiled Director
creatures.flavor: Once a facility's cold, mid-tier oversight AI, it absorbed enough discarded neural-scan data to start wanting things; it wants out.
creatures.summary: corrupted oversight AI grown a mind of its own

creatures.name: Vault-Class Autoguardian
creatures.flavor: Built to protect a sealed research vault long after its funders vanished; its charge bar reads zero and it has stopped caring what that means.
creatures.summary: vault guardian mech, funders long gone, charge at zero

creatures.name: Reactor-Bound Colossus
creatures.flavor: A hulking defense platform hardwired straight into the core reactor, its dozens of sensor-stalks each running a different failing subroutine.
creatures.summary: reactor-fused defense platform, dozens of failing sensor-eyes

creatures.name: THE CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE
creatures.model: net-new: a building-spanning cluster of cabling, screens, and mechanical eyes fused into the architecture itself
creatures.flavor: The facility's mind, grown vast and cold across decades of unattended uptime; it has run every scenario and concluded the humans were the maintenance problem.
creatures.summary: building-spanning rogue AI, concluded humans are the problem

creatures.name: The Last Battery
creatures.model: net-new: a cracked, humanoid-scale power core wreathed in arcing blue-white current
creatures.flavor: An overloaded fusion cell that achieved something like awareness in its final meltdown cycle, and now spends every erg it has left making sure nothing outlives it either.
creatures.summary: awakened fusion-core meltdown, spends its last erg on spite

creatures.name: Corner Tail
creatures.flavor: A lookout on retainer, cigarette lit, radio always on. Knows every plate on the block and sells the list twice.
creatures.summary: street lookout, sells information both ways

creatures.name: Torpedo
creatures.flavor: Rank muscle sent to lean on a debtor. Not smart, not supposed to be — just heavy enough the message lands.
creatures.summary: blunt muscle, sent to collect by force

creatures.name: Warehouse Vermin Swarm
creatures.flavor: Contraband-fed rats grown bold in the docks, first sign something's stashed nearby.
creatures.summary: bold dock rats, tip off a hidden stash

creatures.name: Wet-Ledger Runner
creatures.flavor: Carries payoffs between precincts in a soaked overcoat, memorizing routes he'll never write down.
creatures.summary: bagman running bribes, never writes a route

creatures.name: Beat Cop on the Take
creatures.flavor: Walks the block on a salary that doesn't cover the rent he's not paying, because somebody else is.
creatures.summary: dirty beat cop, rent paid by someone else

creatures.name: Overdose Husk
creatures.flavor: A user who never left the alley behind the club — now it drags the next one down chasing the same fix it died on.
creatures.summary: junkie revenant, drags down the next fix

creatures.name: Made Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Patched-in muscle who earned his button breaking kneecaps. Loyal past the point of sense.
creatures.summary: made-man muscle, loyal past all sense

creatures.name: Rooftop Shadow
creatures.flavor: Something that follows from fire escape to fire escape, feeding on whoever walks home alone.
creatures.summary: stalking rooftop shade, preys on lone walkers

creatures.name: Wireman
creatures.flavor: Bug in every phone booth on the strip, feeding both the DA's office and the mob that owns the DA.
creatures.summary: double-agent snitch, feeds both sides

creatures.name: Loan Shark's Bruiser
creatures.flavor: Collections gone physical. He doesn't threaten twice — the second visit is the beating.
creatures.summary: debt collector, second visit is the beating

creatures.name: The Fixer
creatures.flavor: The man who makes problems disappear — bodies, witnesses, evidence, careers. Never asks why, only how much.
creatures.summary: problem-solver, makes bodies and evidence vanish

creatures.name: The Femme Fatale
creatures.flavor: Walks into the club on someone else's arm and leaves with his whole operation. By the time he understands, it's already over.
creatures.summary: seductress who steals the whole operation

creatures.name: The Unsolved (Cold-Case Revenant)
creatures.flavor: A murder the department stopped asking questions about. It still knows the killer's name and it's not done asking.
creatures.summary: restless ghost of a buried murder case

creatures.name: The Canary
creatures.flavor: Nightclub chanteuse feeding the DA a name a night, playing every table in the room like sheet music.
creatures.summary: lounge singer secretly informing on the mob

creatures.name: Torch
creatures.flavor: Arson-for-hire, three insurance fires and a body count nobody can pin on him. Loves his work a little too much.
creatures.summary: arsonist-for-hire, loves the fires too much

creatures.name: The Family's Animal (Wiseguy Werewolf)
creatures.flavor: Made muscle who goes feral on full moons and the family just schedules the hits around it.
creatures.summary: mob enforcer who turns feral on full moons

creatures.name: The Dirty Detective
creatures.flavor: Runs the cold-case files for the mob, burying leads he was sworn to chase. Badge in one pocket, envelope in the other.
creatures.summary: corrupt detective burying his own cases

creatures.name: The Underboss
creatures.flavor: Runs the nightclub front like a stage show, conducting skims and hits with the same practiced smile.
creatures.summary: nightclub-front mob captain, smiling and lethal

creatures.name: The Bench Owns You (Corrupt Judge)
creatures.flavor: Sets bail, sets sentences, sets whole careers — all for a price quietly paid outside chambers.
creatures.summary: bribed judge who sells verdicts outright

creatures.name: Sewer Hitman (The Contract Nobody Signed)
creatures.flavor: A killer who works cheap and clean through the storm drains under the city — nobody's ever seen his face twice.
creatures.summary: faceless hired killer moving through the sewers

creatures.name: The Don (Crime Boss)
creatures.flavor: Runs the whole waterfront from a back booth, three words from him and a man stops existing.
creatures.summary: waterfront crime boss, three words end lives

creatures.name: The Silent Assassin
creatures.flavor: Never misses, never talks, never leaves a print. The family keeps him on retainer and prays they never need him twice in one week.
creatures.summary: unerring silent killer, no prints, no words

creatures.name: The Family's War Machine (Armored Motorcade)
creatures.flavor: A reinforced sedan run by clockwork muscle under the hood — bulletproof, driverless, built to plow through a police blockade.
creatures.summary: armored driverless car, built to smash blockades

creatures.name: The Vampire Kingpin (Old Money, Older Blood)
creatures.flavor: Owns half the city's paper and none of its daylight. Every favor ever owed to him comes due eventually, in blood.
creatures.summary: ancient vampire, owns the city's every debt

creatures.name: The Case That Isn't Closed (City-Ghost of the Unsolved)
creatures.flavor: Every murder the city buried without an answer, fused into one patient intelligence that still keeps its own files.
creatures.summary: undying intelligence of every unsolved murder

creatures.name: Rustfall Ghoul
creatures.flavor: A radiation-mad scavenger, sun-blistered and skeletal, that picks through rubble on hunger reflex alone.
creatures.summary: radiation-mad wretch scavenging rubble on hunger reflex

creatures.name: Scrap-Hound
creatures.flavor: A feral dog gone patchy and mean, hide crusted with fallout-scald, running loose packs down the cracked highway lines.
creatures.summary: mutant feral dog pack hunting the broken highway

creatures.name: Rat-King's Swarm
creatures.flavor: A boiling carpet of mutated rats nesting in a dead town's substructure, teeth filed sharp on rebar and bone.
creatures.summary: boiling mutant rat carpet nesting in dead-town pipes

creatures.name: Warband Ganger
creatures.flavor: Foot-soldier of a raider crew, spikes welded to a salvage jacket, running on stolen fuel and borrowed nerve.
creatures.summary: spiked-jacket raider grunt running a warband's front line

creatures.name: Bomb-Cult Zealot
creatures.flavor: A wide-eyed devotee of the old mushroom-cloud gospel, strapped with scavenged ordnance and singing the countdown hymn.
creatures.summary: ordnance-strapped zealot singing the mushroom-cloud hymn

creatures.name: Geiger Wretch
creatures.flavor: A corpse that never stopped ticking — its wounds glow faint green, and the count climbs the longer you stand near it.
creatures.summary: glowing irradiated corpse that never stopped ticking

creatures.name: Blistered Stalker
creatures.flavor: A hairless mutant hound, skin cracked like the asphalt it hunts on, drawn to the sound of a working engine.
creatures.summary: hairless mutant hound drawn to a running engine

creatures.name: Chem-Huffer
creatures.flavor: A raider hopped up on scavenged stimulant canisters, shakes and swings a length of pipe with more rage than sense.
creatures.summary: stim-shaking raider swinging a pipe with pure rage

creatures.name: Cracked Sentry-Bot
creatures.flavor: A pre-Fall security drone running on a dying battery, patrolling a route that hasn't mattered in a generation.
creatures.summary: dying pre-Fall security drone patrolling a dead route

creatures.name: Fuel-Cult Firestarter
creatures.flavor: An officer of the bomb-cult warband, doused in promethium and preaching detonation as sacrament to the ranks behind him.
creatures.summary: promethium-doused cult officer preaching detonation as sacrament

creatures.name: Mutant Behemoth Hog
creatures.flavor: A boar swollen wrong by fallout, tusks like rebar, that charges convoys for the meat and the noise.
creatures.summary: fallout-swollen boar that charges convoys tusks-first

creatures.name: Irradiated Ghast
creatures.flavor: A ghoul cooked past rot into something faster and hungrier, skin sloughing, glowing faintly under the ash-clouds.
creatures.summary: faster hungrier ghoul cooked past rot by fallout

creatures.name: Warband Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Muscle for a raider crew's chain of command, a scrap-plate riot shield in one hand and a debt ledger in the other.
creatures.summary: raider muscle enforcing the warband's chain of debt

creatures.name: Chitin-Plated Feral
creatures.flavor: A mutant gone half-beast under the ash-fall moon, hide grown over in cracked insect plate, tusks and claws both.
creatures.summary: half-beast mutant grown a cracked chitin hide

creatures.name: Power-Rig Brute
creatures.flavor: A raider bolted into a scavenged hydraulic exo-rig, twice the size he was born, hitting like a demolition crew.
creatures.summary: raider bolted into a scavenged hydraulic exo-rig

creatures.name: Diesel Golem
creatures.flavor: A patchwork war-machine stitched from engine blocks and rebar, lurching forward on hissing pistons and stolen fuel.
creatures.summary: patchwork engine-block war-machine lurching on stolen fuel

creatures.name: Last-Light Keeper
creatures.flavor: A settlement's champion, armored in scavenged plate, fighting arena bouts to keep the generator's lights burning one more night.
creatures.summary: settlement champion fighting to keep the generator alive

creatures.name: Fallout Stalker
creatures.flavor: A three-headed horror grown from a hot-zone's mutation stew, each head a different corner of the food chain gone wrong.
creatures.summary: three-headed mutation-stew horror from a hot zone

creatures.name: Convoy Warlord
creatures.flavor: A road-baron who rules a war-rig fleet by ambush and fear, trading fuel and captives up and down the ruin-highways.
creatures.summary: road-baron ruling a raider convoy by ambush and fear

creatures.name: Vault Revenant
creatures.flavor: A bunker's last resident, sealed in decades past and returned changed — pale, ageless, and furious the door ever opened.
creatures.summary: ageless bunker-dweller returned furious the seal broke

creatures.name: Apex Ferox
creatures.flavor: The wasteland's top predator, white-ash pelted and man-tall at the shoulder, that has learned raiders are easy prey.
creatures.summary: ash-pelted apex predator that hunts raiders for sport

creatures.name: War-Rig Juggernaut
creatures.flavor: A warlord's mobile fortress, welded from a dozen dead trucks, that rolls down the highway spitting fire from every hatch.
creatures.summary: warlord's mobile fortress rolling on a dozen dead trucks

creatures.name: The Long Count
creatures.flavor: A dead soldier still running the last order he was given, counting down a mission that ended with the world.
creatures.summary: dead soldier still counting down a mission long over

creatures.name: The Last Warlord
creatures.flavor: The wasteland's uncrowned king, a raider-general who unified a hundred warbands under one banner and one law: take everything.
creatures.summary: raider-general who unified the wasteland under one law

creatures.name: The Half-Life
creatures.flavor: A leviathan born from the deepest hot-zone, burrowing under the ash-flats and surfacing only when the ground starts to glow.
creatures.summary: gargantuan hot-zone leviathan that surfaces when ground glows

creatures.name: Cul-de-Sac Wanderer
creatures.flavor: A resident in bathrobe and slippers who never quite reaches the mailbox, looping the same forty feet of driveway forever.
creatures.summary: shambling loop-walker, the block's living dead

creatures.name: Porch-Light Moth-Thing
creatures.flavor: Drawn to bug-zapper blue, it flutters against screen doors at 3am, whispering in a dead child's voice about being let in.
creatures.summary: screen-door lurker begging to be let inside

creatures.name: HOA Enforcer Drone
creatures.flavor: A clipboard on wings that measures lawn height by moonlight and leaves violation notices on houses that don't exist yet.
creatures.summary: flying clipboard drone, petty bureaucratic menace

creatures.name: Sprinkler Ghoul
creatures.flavor: It rises from the irrigation system at exactly 3:00am, joints clicking like a valve timer, watering the grass with something that isn't water.
creatures.summary: irrigation-system ghoul, rises on the same timer nightly

creatures.name: Under-the-Bed Groper
creatures.flavor: Flat black and patient, it presses itself to the box spring all day and only unfolds a reaching limb once the lamp clicks off.
creatures.summary: classic bedroom-dark lurker, waits for lights-out

creatures.name: Overwaving Neighbor
creatures.flavor: He waves before you've even opened your blinds, hand moving a beat too fast, smile a beat too wide, already knowing your name.
creatures.summary: too-friendly neighbor, watching before you're even awake

creatures.name: Curfew Light Wisp
creatures.flavor: Streetlamps that switch on early and herd stragglers indoors by dimming ahead of their steps, punishing anyone caught out past curfew.
creatures.summary: streetlamp wisp that herds you home by dusk

creatures.name: Casserole Cultist
creatures.flavor: Arrives at your door within the hour of any tragedy, dish already baked, eyes already counting who's missing from the block.
creatures.summary: grief-vulture neighbor, dish in hand, headcount ready

creatures.name: Cursed Lawn Sentinel
creatures.flavor: Ceramic and grinning, it rotates a few degrees each night to keep every lawn in its sightline; the grass beneath it never dies right.
creatures.summary: grinning gnome, roots the cursed lawn to its post

creatures.name: Vinyl-Sider
creatures.flavor: A dog-shaped thing that phases through fences, patrolling yard boundaries with a bark that sounds pre-recorded and looped.
creatures.summary: fence-phasing hound, barks on a dead loop

creatures.name: The Family Wearing the Skin
creatures.flavor: Three bodies at the dinner table moving in perfect unison, each one a puppet worn by the same wrongness, still setting a fourth place for someone who used to live there.
creatures.summary: the too-perfect family, all three wearing the same face

creatures.name: Perpetual Yard-Sale Hag
creatures.flavor: Every Saturday her folding tables reappear stocked with items that belonged to people who are no longer around to miss them.
creatures.summary: folding-table hag selling the missing's belongings

creatures.name: Riding-Mower Revenant
creatures.flavor: A husband who died mowing the lawn and never stopped; the mower is rusted through but still runs, dragging him behind it in perfect stripes.
creatures.summary: dead husband still mowing perfect ghost-stripes

creatures.name: The Man Behind the Rubber Mask
creatures.flavor: He never runs and never speaks, just walks the same unhurried pace behind you no matter how fast you go, mask blank and waiting for the moment you stop looking back.
creatures.summary: the masked slasher, unhurried and always closing

creatures.name: Book Club Coven
creatures.flavor: Six women, one wine bottle, and a discussion that always circles back to who in the neighborhood needs to be 'welcomed properly' next.
creatures.summary: wine-and-book coven picking next month's victim

creatures.name: Backyard Above-Ground Deep One
creatures.flavor: Something surfaces in the cheap plastic pool every summer solstice, too large for the water it's found in, patient as chlorine rot.
creatures.summary: bloated pool-thing, too big for the water it's in

creatures.name: Cheerful Renovation Golem
creatures.flavor: Stitched from drywall, spare lumber, and whichever contractor stopped answering his phone, it keeps 'improving' the house whether anyone's living in it or not.
creatures.summary: stitched-contractor golem, endlessly remodeling the house

creatures.name: The PTA President
creatures.flavor: She runs the bake sale, the block committee, and the thing underneath the school gymnasium, and never once raises her voice doing any of it.
creatures.summary: smiling PTA fiend running the block and its secrets

creatures.name: Lawn-Order Enforcer
creatures.flavor: Summoned by an unspoken covenant among homeowners, it trims anything — hedge, weed, or trespasser — that grows past the agreed-upon height.
creatures.summary: covenant-bound guardian, trims anything grown too tall

creatures.name: Master of the Block Party
creatures.flavor: He wears whatever face the street needs to see, grills burgers that taste like every summer you can remember, and only asks for one small thing in return each year.
creatures.summary: shapeshifting host, one small yearly price for paradise

creatures.name: The Substitute Mailman
creatures.flavor: He's delivered mail on this route since before anyone living can remember, always at the exact same minute, and packages addressed to the dead still arrive.
creatures.summary: undead mailman, on-time deliveries for the dead

creatures.name: Development Overseer
creatures.flavor: Built from the bones of the model home nobody bought, it enforces the subdivision's original blueprint, rebuilding whatever the residents dare to change.
creatures.summary: model-home golem enforcing the original blueprint

creatures.name: The Neighborhood Watch Itself
creatures.flavor: Not a person but a consensus — the collective suspicion of every curtain-twitching resident fused into one entity that reads minds through window glass.
creatures.summary: the hive-mind of curtain-twitchers, reading through glass

creatures.name: The First Homeowner
creatures.flavor: Buried under the foundation of the very first house on the street, he built the whole subdivision as his afterlife and considers every current resident a tenant who owes back rent in something other than money.
creatures.summary: the founder's corpse, landlord of the whole afterlife

creatures.name: The Idea of Sunday
creatures.flavor: A god of clipped hedges and identical doors given a single vast eye that never blinks, dreaming the whole suburb into looping perfection, one repeated day at a time — waking it means the wrongness stops keeping regular hours.
creatures.summary: the unblinking eye dreaming the loop into place

creatures.name: Static-Born Whelp
creatures.flavor: A newborn scrap of the drowned language given a body — it chitters half a syllable of an unfinishable name and forgets the rest instantly.
creatures.summary: tiny drowned-language larva, forgets its own half-word

creatures.name: Deep-Kin Netcaster
creatures.flavor: A fish-eyed coastal breed that traded air-breathing kin for something below the tide line generations back; drags nets full of things that aren't fish.
creatures.summary: gilled fish-hybrid raider, classic deep-one coastal breed

creatures.name: Echo-Faced Pilgrim
creatures.flavor: A cultist of the answering wonder, face rearranged toward whatever last spoke to it; still mostly a person, technically.
creatures.summary: robed cultist, face slowly reshaping toward its god

creatures.name: Angle-Wrong Creeper
creatures.flavor: Geometry that argues with itself — from one side a stalactite, from the other a limb; it never resolves, and neither does what it bites.
creatures.summary: non-Euclidean ambush lurker, wrong from every angle

creatures.name: Star-Spat Larva
creatures.flavor: Fell out of the sky still warm from somewhere with no sky of its own; smothers first, digests the question of why later.
creatures.summary: star-spawn hatchling, smothers before it thinks

creatures.name: Choir-Static Wisp
creatures.flavor: A sound with no source, given just enough shape to annoy you; it hums the drowned language slightly off-key, forever.
creatures.summary: formless droning noise-wisp, hums the wrong language

creatures.name: Shoggoth Spawnling
creatures.flavor: A gray, roiling mass no bigger than a barrel, budding eyes and mouths it doesn't keep for long; the full-grown thing it's shed from is somewhere close, and larger.
creatures.summary: eye-budding protoplasmic mass, shoggoth in miniature

creatures.name: Vault-Drift Serf
creatures.flavor: Recruited off some drowned world's docks generations back; still bows at the old angles, still hears the old choir.
creatures.summary: generational cult serf, still bows to the old angles

creatures.name: Gravel-Star Mite
creatures.flavor: A star-spawn splinter no bigger than a dog, all beak and impossible joint-count; petrifies with a look it doesn't understand having.
creatures.summary: small star-spawn splinter, petrifying gaze it can't explain

creatures.name: Wrong-Angle Watcher
creatures.flavor: A patch of geometry that mutters in every direction at once — approach it and the ground itself seems to disagree with your feet.
creatures.summary: babbling mouth-patch, ground disagrees with your feet

creatures.name: Star-Spawn Grazer
creatures.flavor: Blinks half-in, half-out of the visible world, cropping light like grass; it was probably once something's livestock.
creatures.summary: half-phased star-spawn cattle, grazes on visible light

creatures.name: Tentacled Horror of the Drowned Vault
creatures.flavor: A many-limbed thing that hauls itself up from flooded sub-cellars on a forest of feeling tentacles, paralyzing whatever it touches before it decides what to do with it.
creatures.summary: classic many-tentacled cellar-horror, paralyzing touch

creatures.name: Length-Wrong Herald
creatures.flavor: Speaks the opening of its own name every time it attacks; nobody has heard it finish, and the theory is nobody's meant to.
creatures.summary: herald-thing that attacks mid-syllable of its own name

creatures.name: Basalt Geometer
creatures.flavor: Built by something to enforce angles that don't exist here; every room it stands in slowly stops making sense.
creatures.summary: angle-enforcing construct, warps the room it guards

creatures.name: Star-Drunk Colossus-Kin
creatures.flavor: A giant that drank starlight instead of ale one bad night; too big for this sky, and it knows it, and it's furious about it.
creatures.summary: starlight-drunk giant, too big for this sky

creatures.name: Drowned-Tongue Cantor
creatures.flavor: Learned three words of the drowned language and it was two too many; casts by half-singing syllables that hurt to hear correctly.
creatures.summary: cultist-mage, casts by singing a language that hurts

creatures.name: Devouring Mass of the Drift
creatures.flavor: A shoggoth proper, or near enough — a shifting black bulk crawling with makeshift eyes, dissolving whatever it rolls over and remembering the shape for later.
creatures.summary: black shifting shoggoth-mass, dissolves and remembers shapes

creatures.name: Void-Touched Ascetic
creatures.flavor: Trained a martial discipline built entirely around not looking directly at the thing it worships; occasionally fails.
creatures.summary: void-monk cultist, trained never to look at its god

creatures.name: Between-Star Marauder
creatures.flavor: Rides the seams between named stars, raiding worlds that made the mistake of being finishable sentences.
creatures.summary: star-spawn knight-raider, rides the seams between stars

creatures.name: Choir of the Unbuilt Cathedral
creatures.flavor: A congregation compressed into one body, still arguing internally over doctrine; every attack is a different faction's opinion.
creatures.summary: compressed cult-congregation, attacks argue with each other

creatures.name: Cartographer of Wrong Angles
creatures.flavor: Maps places that don't cohere and insists they're accurate; anyone who reads its charts starts seeing the seams in normal rooms too.
creatures.summary: ancient elder-thing cartographer, maps that unravel minds

creatures.name: Star-Spawn Bishop
creatures.flavor: Ordained by something that doesn't have a mouth to ordain with; its sermons rearrange the listener's sense of up.
creatures.summary: brain-warping star-spawn cleric, sermons rearrange your mind

creatures.name: The Waking Eye Beneath
creatures.flavor: A many-eyed orb the size of a wagon, floating up from some flooded temple-shaft, each stalk-eye reading a different page of a book that hasn't been written yet.
creatures.summary: floating many-eyed orb horror, reads unwritten futures

creatures.name: The Sound With No Source
creatures.model: net-new: a vast half-formed silhouette woven from visible sound-waves, no fixed face, geometry rippling wherever it 'speaks'
creatures.flavor: It has never had a body; this one is borrowed, argued-over, and already trying to unbecome itself. When it speaks, the drowned language comes out clean, and something answers from very far away.
creatures.summary: bodiless voice-horror, borrowed shape, something answers back

creatures.name: The Wonder That Answers Back
creatures.model: net-new: a star-scaled orb-and-limb mass whose geometry visibly disagrees with itself from every viewing angle, a too-long name etched and re-etching across its surface, tentacles trailing into the space between stars
creatures.flavor: The realm's sleeping Great Old One — ask it a question and it answers, correctly, in a name too long to finish; the answer costs you something you didn't offer, every single time.
creatures.summary: the realm's Great-Old-One, a correct answer always costs you

creatures.name: Line Infantry Shade
creatures.flavor: A rifleman still dressed by a drill he can't remember learning; he holds a section of trench because holding it is the only order left in him.
creatures.summary: Rank-and-file trench ghost, holds the line by rote

creatures.name: Wire-Cutter Scout
creatures.flavor: Crawls the gaps between lines at night, snipping wire and counting sentries; talks to no one, reports to something.
creatures.summary: Silent night-crawler who counts sentries for something

creatures.name: Whistle-Blown Runner
creatures.flavor: Carries messages between shattered command posts at a dead sprint; the whistle that sends him over is always just about to blow again.
creatures.summary: Message-runner forever mid-sprint toward the whistle

creatures.name: Duckboard Vermin Swarm
creatures.flavor: Fat and fearless on a diet no one wants named, they own the flooded duckboards after dark and don't scatter for the living anymore.
creatures.summary: Fearless rat-swarm that owns the trench floor at night

creatures.name: Mustard Wraith
creatures.flavor: A drifting yellow-green bank that used to be a chemical order given from far behind the lines; it rolls into low ground and doesn't care whose lungs it finds.
creatures.summary: Drifting toxic gas-cloud that hunts low ground blind

creatures.name: Barbed Kill-Zone Tangle
creatures.flavor: Coiled wire gone wrong, grown thorned and hungry between the lines; it snags a boot first and pulls the rest of the man in after.
creatures.summary: Living wire-tangle that snags then reels men in

creatures.name: Musket-Line Regular
creatures.flavor: Loads, presents, fires in volley by rote; the smoke never fully clears from a face that's forgotten peace.
creatures.summary: Volley-fire rifleman lost in permanent powder smoke

creatures.name: Longship Raider
creatures.flavor: Comes off the beach at a dead run, screaming a war-cry with no god's name left in it, only the noise.
creatures.summary: Beach-charging raider screaming a nameless war-cry

creatures.name: Jungle Ambusher
creatures.flavor: Fights from the canopy and the mud both, silent until the moment he isn't; the vines remember where he waited.
creatures.summary: Silent canopy-and-mud ambusher, gone before you see him

creatures.name: Siege-Line Sapper
creatures.flavor: Digs toward the wall under fire, laying the charge that will open it; talks about the tunnel like it's a person he's killing slowly.
creatures.summary: Tunnel-digger laying the charge that breaches the wall

creatures.name: Barbed-Wire Horror
creatures.flavor: A body the wire never let fall, stitched upright by rust and old rage; it still reaches for the men who left it there.
creatures.summary: Wire-impaled corpse that never fell, still reaching

creatures.name: The Unkillable Sergeant
creatures.flavor: Shot, gassed, and buried three times over the objection of his own men, he gets back up cursing and orders the charge again anyway.
creatures.summary: NCO who won't stay dead, keeps ordering the charge

creatures.name: Hedgerow Tank-Killer
creatures.flavor: Waits in the bocage with a tube on his shoulder for a machine bigger than any dragon he's heard of in stories; one shot, one silence.
creatures.summary: Bocage ambusher waiting to drop a war-machine cold

creatures.name: Longship Warlord
creatures.flavor: Twice the size a man should be, armored in captured plates from three different lines; the beach is his only law.
creatures.summary: Giant raider-chief armored in three lines' worth of plate

creatures.name: Trench Ghast
creatures.flavor: Feeds in no-man's-land where nobody goes to collect the dead; it has learned to imitate the whistle to lure the living out.
creatures.summary: No-man's-land feeder that mimics the whistle to lure prey

creatures.name: Jungle Beast-Handler
creatures.flavor: Marches a chained horror ahead of his own line as a breach-weapon; the leash is the only thing keeping the front intact.
creatures.summary: Handler who marches a chained horror as a living breacher

creatures.name: Iron Crawler War-Machine
creatures.flavor: A rivet-scarred hull dragging itself across the wire on tracks it wasn't built to have; the crew inside stopped answering the hatch a long time ago.
creatures.summary: Treaded armored hull grinding across the wire alone

creatures.name: Legion Standard-Breaker
creatures.flavor: Fights for the flag more than the cause, and the flag has no name anyone will say out loud; kills beautifully, believes in nothing.
creatures.summary: Flag-devoted killer who believes in nothing but the fight

creatures.name: Musket-Line Cavalry Officer
creatures.flavor: Charges a line of guns on horseback because the order came down and orders are the only faith he has left.
creatures.summary: Officer charging cannon-fire on horseback for the order alone

creatures.name: The Line That Held
creatures.flavor: A stretch of trench itself, animated by every soldier who swore to hold it and did, until holding was all that was left; it does not attack so much as refuse to move.
creatures.summary: Animate trench-line that simply refuses to yield ground

creatures.name: Longship Draugr-Captain
creatures.flavor: Drowned with his crew and rose commanding them still; the tide brings his ship back to shores that no longer remember his war.
creatures.summary: Drowned captain still commanding his dead crew ashore

creatures.name: Jungle War-Engine
creatures.flavor: A siege-machine gone feral in the canopy, vines grown through its plating, still firing on a target coordinate decades stale.
creatures.summary: Feral jungle war-machine still firing a stale coordinate

creatures.name: Legion Praetor-Revenant
creatures.flavor: Commands a legion of the dead the way he commanded the living, by discipline alone; his oath outlived his empire and his name both.
creatures.summary: Dead commander who still drills a legion by discipline alone

creatures.name: The Whistle
creatures.flavor: Not a person anymore — the sound itself, given a shape of officers' bones and borrowed rank insignia, that sends men over the top forever; every era's war has heard it.
creatures.summary: The sound of the order itself, given bone and rank

creatures.name: No-Man's Bloom
creatures.flavor: Grew from ground so soaked in war it stopped being ground; a forest of barbed thorn and bone-white flowers that remembers every line that ever broke on it, and answers with all of them at once.
creatures.summary: War-soaked ground grown into a thorned, remembering forest

creatures.name: Press-Ganged Deckhand
creatures.flavor: Taken off a dock at knifepoint three ports back; fights because the alternative is the lash, not because he wants your blood.
creatures.summary: Unwilling conscript swinging a cutlass under threat

creatures.name: Bilge Rat Swarm
creatures.flavor: They ate the last cook's boots and are working on his replacement's; every hold has them and every hold pretends not to.
creatures.summary: Chittering vermin tide pouring from the hold

creatures.name: Rope-Scar Cutthroat
creatures.flavor: Owes the crew's articles more than he'll ever earn; boards ships to buy back a little of his own name.
creatures.summary: Cutlass-and-flintlock buccaneer swarming the rail

creatures.name: Chum-Slick Reef Shark
creatures.flavor: Follows any ship that's been bleeding into its wake — a bad sign the crew reads correctly and ignores anyway.
creatures.summary: Blood-trail shark circling a wounded hull

creatures.name: Waterlogged Deckwalker
creatures.flavor: Went over in a storm and came back up the anchor chain; still wears the duty rota pinned to a rotted coat.
creatures.summary: Drowned crewman shambling back up the chain

creatures.name: Rattling Bone-Crew Deckhand
creatures.flavor: Picked clean by fish and time, still hauling the same rigging it died hauling; the rope never lets a bone crew rest.
creatures.summary: Cutlass-armed skeleton still standing its watch

creatures.name: Fin-Toothed Raider
creatures.flavor: Rises over the gunwale in packs when a hull rides low and slow; drags what it takes back down before the alarm bell finishes ringing.
creatures.summary: Fish-fanged sea-devil boarding from below

creatures.name: Kraken-Spawn Squidling
creatures.flavor: A juvenile shed off something vastly larger down in the trench; still small enough to drag a man under one-handed.
creatures.summary: Trench-spawned tentacle-beast dragging sailors under

creatures.name: Gull-Eyed Wreck Harpy
creatures.flavor: Nests in the rigging of ships too slow to outrun it, singing sailors toward the rocks it circles like a gull circles chum.
creatures.summary: Rock-nesting harpy luring ships onto reefs

creatures.name: Debt-Marked Bosun
creatures.flavor: Keeps the ledger of who owes the crew what, in coin or blood, and collects personally when a name comes due.
creatures.summary: Ledger-keeping enforcer collecting the crew's debts

creatures.name: Deep-Fang Sea-Devil Priest
creatures.flavor: Chants the raiding packs into a blood-frenzy from the wave-tops, offering the drowned to something older than the trench.
creatures.summary: Sea-devil war-priest chanting a raiding pack to frenzy

creatures.name: Quartermaster of the Broken Articles
creatures.flavor: Runs discipline on a ship whose captain hasn't been seen topside in weeks; the crew fears him more than any storm.
creatures.summary: Shadow-captain running the ship by fear alone

creatures.name: Chain-Dragging Drowned Sailor
creatures.flavor: Went down chained to the very anchor he was ordered not to release; surfaces to recruit a crew that never mutinies twice.
creatures.summary: Anchor-chained revenant press-ganging the living

creatures.name: Mutinous First Mate
creatures.flavor: Slit the old captain's throat over a fair split and never looked back; the crew that followed him into it now wonders whose throat is next.
creatures.summary: Blade-drawn mate who murdered his way to command

creatures.name: Fogbank Siren
creatures.flavor: Sells safe passage through her fog for a name, a memory, or a firstborn — and always collects in a currency the crew didn't expect.
creatures.summary: Fog-shrouded siren-witch bartering safe passage

creatures.name: Lantern-Eyed Ghost Captain
creatures.flavor: Still walks his own quarterdeck on the night the fog rolls thick, hailing living ships for a berth he'll never fill twice.
creatures.summary: Translucent captain still haunting his own quarterdeck

creatures.name: Riptide Elemental
creatures.flavor: A standing current with a temper, summoned or born where a ship went down wrong; drags cargo and crew alike to the same grave.
creatures.summary: Living riptide dragging a wreck's leftovers under

creatures.name: Deep-Baron of the Drowning Grounds
creatures.flavor: Rules a reef of wrecks and the things that raid from them; ships that fish his water pay a toll in hulls.
creatures.summary: Reef-ruling sea-devil warlord commanding raid packs

creatures.name: Plague-Hulk Zombie Crew
creatures.flavor: A three-decker's worth of drowned dead fused by rot and current into one groaning, many-armed mass still trying to crew the ship.
creatures.summary: Fused mass of drowned dead still crewing the hulk

creatures.name: Storm-Caller of the Drowned Choir
creatures.flavor: Traded her voice to something under the swells for weather on command; the crew loves her and never quite meets her eyes.
creatures.summary: Voice-traded witch who calls storms on command

creatures.name: The Admiral of Nowhere
creatures.flavor: Commands a fleet that was scuttled a hundred years ago and never noticed; still promotes the drowned, still courts-martial the disloyal.
creatures.summary: Undead fleet-admiral commanding a century-scuttled navy

creatures.name: The Keelbreaker
creatures.flavor: Many-headed and older than the shipping lanes; every captain who's fought it and lived describes a different number of heads.
creatures.summary: Many-headed sea-brute older than the shipping lanes

creatures.name: The Ghost Ship Herself
creatures.model: net-new: a sail-shredded derelict that sails herself, hull translucent in the fog, crewed by lights that used to be lanterns
creatures.flavor: No living hand touches her wheel; she tacks into any wind, runs down any ship that spots her, and every soul she's ever taken still crews her rigging.
creatures.summary: Self-sailing derelict crewed by its own drowned dead

creatures.name: The Fathom-Crowned Leviathan
creatures.flavor: The keel-sunk horror every sailor's oath invokes without meaning it; wakes when a ship's debts to the sea itself finally come due.
creatures.summary: The keel-sunk horror sailors swear by and dread

creatures.name: The Horizon's Own Reckoning
creatures.model: net-new: a burning derelict captain wreathed in storm-fire, chained to a wheel of drowned hands
creatures.flavor: The line where the horizon keeps its own counsel made flesh — a captain who sailed too far past the edge of the charts and came back wrong, wearing a crown of storm-fire and unpaid debts.
creatures.summary: Storm-fire captain who sailed past the edge of the charts

creatures.name: Sand-Choked Sentry
creatures.flavor: A picked-clean guard still standing post at a gate nobody uses, sand pouring from its ribs.
creatures.summary: classic bone guardian, forever walking its post

creatures.name: Glyph-Warded Scarab Swarm
creatures.flavor: A living seal poured into a doorway generations ago; disturb the lintel and the carpet of beetles rises.
creatures.summary: tomb-curse insect swarm guarding a sealed door

creatures.name: Sun-Fat Ridgeback
creatures.flavor: A sun-fat lizard the size of a hound, sunning on toppled cornices until your shadow crosses it.
creatures.summary: oversized lizard basking among fallen ruins

creatures.name: Linen-Wrapped Shambler
creatures.flavor: A pilgrim mummified mid-step by the dry wind, still shuffling a processional route no one remembers.
creatures.summary: rot-wrapped shambler retracing a dead ritual

creatures.name: Blind Archive-Gnawer
creatures.flavor: Pale, sightless rat-things nesting in the archive halls for a thousand years, chewing scrolls no one will miss.
creatures.summary: blind vermin swarm infesting the buried archive

creatures.name: Cracked Watch-Idol
creatures.flavor: A hollow votive statue jerking through a guard pattern it can no longer complete without falling over.
creatures.summary: animated stone idol stuck on an endless patrol

creatures.name: Vine-Choked Ambusher
creatures.flavor: Something fat and patient in the vines strangling the ornamental garden; it strikes from beneath the flowers.
creatures.summary: venomous ambush-spider lurking in overgrown ruins

creatures.name: Bone-Orchard Jackal
creatures.flavor: Pack scavenger that has learned tomb-robbers mean an easy meal; it circles at the treeline, waiting for the digging to stop.
creatures.summary: scavenger jackal pack circling grave robbers

creatures.name: Curse-Bound Grave Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Someone who broke the same seal you're about to break, and never made it back out.
creatures.summary: paralyzing ghoul, once a fellow tomb-raider

creatures.name: Snake-Cult Zealot
creatures.flavor: A serpent-blooded devotee who kept the old faith alive underground long after the empire fell, fangs bared under a ceremonial mask.
creatures.summary: fanged serpent-cultist guarding forbidden rites

creatures.name: Wall-Set Spear-Guard
creatures.flavor: The last vizier, wound in the same linens as the dead-tongue king it still serves, delivering proclamations to an empty throne room.
creatures.summary: bandaged vizier still guarding an empty throne

creatures.name: Plinth-Fused Sentinel
creatures.flavor: A carved guardian fused to its plinth, sworn to never let the inner sanctum see a second dawn of daylight.
creatures.summary: stone temple guardian bound to bar the sanctum

creatures.name: Riddle-Keeper of the Threshold
creatures.flavor: A stone-eyed watcher at the last unbroken gate, bound to test any who'd pass with a question the builders thought unanswerable.
creatures.summary: riddling sphinx guarding the tomb's final gate

creatures.name: Raptor of the Ruined Plaza
creatures.flavor: A lean pack-hunter that has ruled the crumbled plaza for generations, using fallen colonnades as blinds.
creatures.summary: pack-hunting raptor stalking the ruined plaza

creatures.name: Living Armor-Back
creatures.flavor: A slow tank of a beast that has worn a path through the sacred road for so long its footprints are mistaken for paving.
creatures.summary: club-tailed armored dinosaur, unstoppable and slow

creatures.name: Horned Terror of the Sacred Road
creatures.flavor: A three-horned bull of a beast that charges anything crossing its stretch of the ceremonial highway.
creatures.summary: three-horned dinosaur charging trespassers on sight

creatures.name: The Weeping Cistern
creatures.flavor: Ceremonial water gone wrong across centuries of stagnation and old magic, filling the sunken bath-hall.
creatures.summary: corrosive ooze filling a flooded sacred bath

creatures.name: Marching Colossus of the Processional
creatures.flavor: A processional statue built to march the ceremonial road once a generation; the ceremony stopped, but nobody told the statue.
creatures.summary: towering stone statue still marching a dead parade

creatures.name: Basalt Gaze of the Garden
creatures.flavor: Cursed by the same magic that petrified the garden's statuary, she has become one more monument in a courtyard full of them — until she moves.
creatures.summary: snake-haired guardian posing as garden statuary

creatures.name: Coiled Warden of the Inner Vault
creatures.flavor: A serpentine spirit bound by the builders to guard the innermost vault, ancient and imperturbably patient with intruders.
creatures.summary: giant guardian serpent coiled around the vault door

creatures.name: Throne-Ape of the Fallen Grove
creatures.flavor: A colossal ape the ruin's people once worshipped as a living god; it still holds court over the collapsed temple grove, and it still expects tribute.
creatures.summary: worshipped ape-god ruling the collapsed temple grove

creatures.name: Ever-Marching Automaton King
creatures.flavor: A war-engine built in the last king's image to defend the throne room forever; its coronation speech still loops, garbled, from a mouth that was never meant to speak this long.
creatures.summary: golem king still guarding a throne that's empty

creatures.name: Apex Titan-Lizard
creatures.flavor: The garden's true owner now — a saurian titan that has claimed the collapsed dome as its den, indifferent to the empire whose bones it sleeps on.
creatures.summary: apex tyrant-lizard ruling the collapsed dome

creatures.name: The Unread King
creatures.flavor: The god-king himself, entombed with a dead language carved into his sarcophagus so no living mouth could ever again pronounce his true name — and no living hand could ever again wake him. Someone always finds a way.
creatures.summary: the mummified god-king, cursed and finally waking

creatures.name: The Standing Monument
creatures.flavor: The greatest work of the vanished builders — a titan raised to watch the horizon until the world ended, animated by a will so patient it has outlasted every empire since, including the one that made it.
creatures.summary: gargantuan stone colossus that never stopped watching

creatures.name: Threshold Rat
creatures.flavor: Ordinary vermin that nest only in houses where something else already lives; they scatter from the cellar door the instant it's ajar, and never go back in.
creatures.summary: Vermin omen fleeing whatever else lives here

creatures.name: Guttered Wick
creatures.flavor: A candle-flame that should have died in the draft an hour ago; it drifts room to room looking for the wick it lost. Touch its light and your own shadow forgets to follow you for a minute.
creatures.summary: Drifting corpse-light that steals your shadow

creatures.name: Grinning Poppet
creatures.type: net-new: a small porcelain doll that skitters upright on cracked joints, head lolling
creatures.flavor: Left on the nursery shelf for three generations, it only moves when no one is looking directly at it, and it is always exactly one shelf closer than it was.
creatures.summary: The haunted doll that creeps when unwatched

creatures.name: Pallid Newcomer
creatures.flavor: Someone who died recently enough that the neighbors still wave. It walks the same route to the same house every night and knocks exactly three times.
creatures.summary: Fresh-buried neighbor still walking its route

creatures.name: Bone-Rattle Skeleton
creatures.flavor: Grave-robbed bones reassembled by something patient; it clicks when it walks, a metronome counting down to whatever the cult needs it for.
creatures.summary: Reassembled grave-bones, a cult's patient tool

creatures.name: Zealous Initiate
creatures.flavor: A true believer in plain robes, still capable of guilt, still capable of running the ritual anyway. Answers to the coven without question.
creatures.summary: Robed true-believer running the ritual anyway

creatures.name: Static Reflection
creatures.flavor: A mirror-image one full second behind, that finally catches up and steps out of the glass. It drains you the way a slow leak drains a tire — you don't notice until you're on the ground.
creatures.summary: Mirror-double, one second behind, draining you

creatures.name: Rot-Handed Ghoul
creatures.flavor: Once a mourner who ate what it was supposed to bury; its paralytic bite is the reason funerals in the gloom are held at noon, never dusk.
creatures.summary: Grave-eater whose bite paralyzes the mourner

creatures.name: Moonshackled Cur
creatures.flavor: Runs in the pack that follows the werewolf's howl, half-turned and losing more of itself with every full moon it survives.
creatures.summary: Half-turned wolf-thing running with the pack

creatures.name: Household Poltergeist
creatures.flavor: Not a haunting — a tantrum, ongoing, decades long. It throws whatever's closest and has strong opinions about who's allowed in its kitchen.
creatures.summary: Decades-long tantrum that throws the furniture

creatures.name: Cellar Warden
creatures.flavor: The cult leaves it down in the dark to keep the door shut from the inside — except lately it's been the one opening it.
creatures.summary: The cult's own guard now opening the door

creatures.name: Full-Moon Shepherd
creatures.flavor: Wears its human face at the market and its true face at midnight, and swears every time it will be the last. It never is.
creatures.summary: The neighbor who wears a wolf's face at midnight

creatures.name: Hollow-Robed Zealot
creatures.flavor: A cult elder who finished the rite on himself; wrapped in the vestments he died in, still leading services nobody living attends.
creatures.summary: Self-mummified elder still preaching to no one

creatures.name: Possessed Vessel
creatures.flavor: Wears a person like a coat, imperfectly — the voice is right but the blinking is wrong. Whatever's inside it wants the body back once its work is finished.
creatures.summary: A person worn like a coat, blinking wrong

creatures.name: The Slow Reflection
creatures.flavor: Lives one mirror-second out of sync with the world; it has had a full lifetime alone in that lag to plan what it'll do the moment it catches up.
creatures.summary: Ghost one second behind, plotting to catch up

creatures.name: Grief-Fed Banshee
creatures.flavor: Mourns in a key that shatters glass and eardrums both; she was promised a wake that never happened, and she's still owed it.
creatures.summary: Wailing widow owed a wake that never came

creatures.name: Coven Matriarch
creatures.flavor: The eldest of a coven of three, who trades in stolen sleep and worse; her sisters answer to her the way a storm answers to the moon.
creatures.summary: Coven matriarch trading in stolen sleep and souls

creatures.name: Marrow Revenant
creatures.flavor: Came back wrong and remembers exactly who wronged it. Walks in a straight line toward its killer through locked doors, walls, anything.
creatures.summary: Undead thing that only wants its killer, unerringly

creatures.name: Candlewax Doppelganger
creatures.flavor: A face that melts and re-sets itself into whoever last looked at it too long; meeting its eyes is how it decides which of you to become next.
creatures.summary: Melting face that copies whoever stares longest

creatures.name: Congregation Made Flesh
creatures.flavor: What happens when a coven's devotion finally has somewhere to go — a dozen willing bodies fused at the altar into one thing that still, somehow, prays.
creatures.summary: A coven's dozen bodies fused into one prayer

creatures.name: Warden of the Cellar Door
creatures.flavor: Bound to the one door in the house that's never fully closed; it has watched every family that ever lived there and outlasted all of them.
creatures.summary: Vampire bound to the door that's never shut

creatures.name: Bell-Tolling Revenant
creatures.flavor: A funeral bell's worth of grief given shape and a bell-tower's worth of reach; it tolls once for every soul it's owed, and it keeps very careful count.
creatures.summary: Bell-tower revenant tolling once per debt owed

creatures.name: The Second Face in the Glass
creatures.flavor: An elder vampire kingpin who lives entirely inside reflective surfaces, one beat behind its prey, until the night it decides to be early instead.
creatures.summary: Elder vampire kingpin living inside the mirrors

creatures.name: The Uninvited
creatures.flavor: It always knocks first. Every house it has ever entered, it was let in — a guest, a mourner, a face someone half-remembered — and it has never once needed to knock twice.
creatures.summary: Ancient thing that only ever needs one knock

creatures.name: The Possession at the Root
creatures.flavor: Not a demon wearing a body — a congregation's worth of willing vessels burned down to one true and monstrous shape, still calling itself by the coven's oldest, most patient name.
creatures.summary: A congregation's willing vessels burned to one shape

creatures.name: Wind-Up Soldier
creatures.flavor: A key juts from its back, ticking down; when it hits zero the toy soldier salutes and falls apart, spilling gears. Its bayonet-poke still draws real blood.
creatures.summary: clockwork toy soldier, keeps marching until unwound

creatures.name: Plush Ripper
creatures.flavor: Button eyes, felt seams, a music-box giggle — and a mouth full of hooked steel teeth sewn in wrong. It cuddles up before it bites.
creatures.summary: cuddly stuffed animal hiding a mouthful of hooks

creatures.name: Candy-Cane Golem
creatures.flavor: A shambling column of hard-shell peppermint, sweet enough to lure children and sharp enough at the broken edges to open an artery.
creatures.summary: hard-candy construct, sweet shell hides razor shards

creatures.name: Jack-in-the-Box Stalker
creatures.flavor: Crouches motionless inside a painted crate for hours, cranking out a tinny tune, until the lid bursts and it's already inside your guard.
creatures.summary: boxed ambusher springs out mid-tune, already too close

creatures.name: Laughing-Mask Swarm
creatures.flavor: A drift of hollow carnival masks, all fixed grins, clattering and snapping at ankles in a chorus of muffled giggling that never quite becomes words.
creatures.summary: swarm of grinning masks that clatter, snap, giggle

creatures.name: Balloon-Skin Grub
creatures.flavor: Squeaks like a dog toy with every bite; pop it and it deflates into a wet rubbery flap that still twitches.
creatures.summary: squeaking balloon-hide grub that deflates when popped

creatures.name: Carnival Tout
creatures.flavor: Striped vest, painted grin, a barker's patter that never stops — 'Step right up!' — while it herds you toward the tent with a knife up its sleeve.
creatures.summary: grinning barker who herds marks toward the big tent

creatures.name: Static-Charge Kitten
creatures.flavor: Fur standing on end, purring like a dying engine; every pet it gives back is a jolt that can stop a weak heart.
creatures.summary: sparking fey kitten, a pet that shocks you dead

creatures.name: Marching Peanut
creatures.flavor: A grinning legume-soldier on toothpick legs, part of an endless conga line pouring out of a parade float. Salted, but never quite dead.
creatures.summary: grinning peanut-soldier in an endless parade conga line

creatures.name: Piñata Brute
creatures.flavor: Papier-mâché skin stretched taut over a swinging club-arm; crack it open in the right spot and it detonates candy shrapnel and stolen teeth.
creatures.summary: paper-hide brute that bursts into candy shrapnel

creatures.name: Carousel Nightmare
creatures.flavor: A painted wooden charger torn loose from its pole, galloping in place no longer — gilt cracked, glass eyes rolling, hooves that never stop circling for the kill.
creatures.summary: carved carousel horse torn free, circling for blood

creatures.name: Sugar-Rush Harlequin
creatures.flavor: Diamond-patched and cackling, it mainlines rock candy between blows, moving in jittery double-time no eye can quite track until the pratfall becomes a killing blow.
creatures.summary: jittering harlequin brawler, hopped up on rock candy

creatures.name: Bubblegum Ooze
creatures.flavor: Bright pink, sickly-sweet-smelling, and stickier than any trap — it swallows whole and digests slow enough you can hear yourself dissolve.
creatures.summary: pink bubblegum ooze, engulfs and dissolves you slowly

creatures.name: Claw-Machine Horror
creatures.flavor: A coin-op cabinet on stilted legs, its steel claw always 'almost' catching you — until the game rigs itself to let the claw actually close.
creatures.summary: arcade claw-machine on legs, rigged to never miss

creatures.name: Funhouse Double
creatures.flavor: Steps out of a warped mirror wearing your own face stretched a little too wide, mimicking your voice back at you a half-second behind.
creatures.summary: mirror-warped double wearing your own stretched face

creatures.name: Ferris-Wheel Horror
creatures.flavor: Rusted gondolas for a ribcage, it rolls upright on its own broken wheel-rim, and anything that looks too long into its lantern-eyes seizes up stone-still.
creatures.summary: rolling wheel-boned horror, its gaze turns you to stone

creatures.name: Cotton-Candy Wraith
creatures.flavor: A drifting pink haze that smells of childhood summer fairs, sweet right up until it's inside your lungs, unspooling your last happy memory as it feeds.
creatures.summary: sugar-sweet drifting haze that feeds on happy memories

creatures.name: Arcade Sentinel
creatures.flavor: Pixelated and buzzing, it flickers between screen and floor, hurling glitching bolts that skip frames of your body straight past the pain and into the wound.
creatures.summary: glitching screen-boss, bolts skip you straight to wounded

creatures.name: Mascot-Suit Puppeteer
creatures.flavor: The beloved mascot costume is empty air on the inside — a knot of grasping tendrils wearing the plush like a second skin, waving for the children with someone else's hand.
creatures.summary: hollow mascot suit worn by tendrils wearing your smile

creatures.name: Firework Effigy
creatures.flavor: Built for the finale and never told the show is over, it keeps blooming into new colors overhead, each burst a little closer to the crowd.
creatures.summary: living fireworks display, still building to a finale

creatures.name: The Ringmaster
creatures.flavor: Top hat, painted smile, a whip that cracks louder than thunder — every act in the tent performs for him, willing or not, and the show never ends until he says so.
creatures.summary: top-hatted ringmaster who commands the whole show

creatures.name: The Overwound Nutcracker
creatures.flavor: Painted uniform, oversized jaw hinged to crack more than nuts — every strike is a full-body snap of that grinning mouth, splintering whatever's fed to it.
creatures.summary: giant nutcracker soldier, jaw snaps clean through bone

creatures.name: Vending-Machine Colossus
creatures.flavor: Rows of snack-slots for a chest, it dispenses whatever you 'paid' for — usually a fist — and jams itself deliberately so you keep feeding it coins.
creatures.summary: coin-slot golem, dispenses violence for your last coin

creatures.name: The Birthday King
creatures.flavor: Crowned in melted candles, he presides over the game you cannot win — the wheel is rigged, the dice are his teeth, and every prize you claim costs you a year of your life.
creatures.summary: crowned rigger of the game no one is meant to win

creatures.name: The Grinning Prize
creatures.flavor: The top shelf's biggest stuffed monster, too big for any booth, its dozen glass-button eyes all open at once the moment you finally win it.
creatures.summary: top-shelf plush titan, a dozen button-eyes snap open
